payload.title: N&NP supplemental original document and historical output archive
payload.body:
# N&NP supplemental original document and historical output archive

130 exact screened original files; source1928646bytes, public1906237bytes. Original RW/MCSP/THR2 and checkpoint documents, bibliographic citations and own annotations retain unreviewed historical claims and correction/stopping records. Four historical MCSP/THR2 inputs remain bounded-not-found. Original mixed-output and Python-literal files with .json names are kept as historical text, not repaired or claimed valid JSON. No actual RW witness, P versus NP conclusion, fresh run or logical proof verification is accepted.

83 files remain byte-identical;47 have only declared local/coordination/provenance/attributed-provider field spans projected. Thirty private-source cached metadata records become anonymous stat-only placeholders; neither underlying private source body was read. One long third-party abstract field is omitted while its reference and own research annotations remain. Original own-text/data licence and disclosed human/AI roles apply; source-provider words retain their rights. This artifact-check REVIEW assesses static byte/provenance preservation and is inconclusive about scientific validity.
